edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, The Guardian reported “only weeks before the election in Israel on 27 October.”; on 2026-10-07, Deutsche Welle reported “The anniversary of the attacks also comes just ahead of the October 27 elections in Israel.”.
On 2026-09-08, The Guardian reported “only weeks before the election in Israel on 27 October.”; on 2026-10-07, UPI reported “The first general election since the attacks scheduled for Oct. 27”.

On 2026-09-08, USA Today reported “Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing an election on October 27, with polls showing his ruling coalition is likely to lose several seats and fall short of a majority.”; on 2026-10-07, Deutsche Welle reported “The anniversary of the attacks also comes just ahead of the October 27 elections in Israel.”.

On 2026-09-08, USA Today reported “Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing an election on October 27, with polls showing his ruling coalition is likely to lose several seats and fall short of a majority.”; on 2026-10-07, UPI reported “The first general election since the attacks scheduled for Oct. 27”.

On 2026-09-08, USA Today reported “Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing an election on October 27, with polls showing his ruling coalition is likely to lose several seats and fall short of a majority.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “only weeks before the election in Israel on 27 October.”.
